title: Remelting scrap ingots of iron or steel

review.classification: The positive physical example is Algerian Customs RTC 067/DGD dated 5 November 2024, in the February 2025 compendium, printed page 68 / PDF page 74. Customs assigned 7204.50.00.00 to irregular rough-cast alloy-steel scrap ingots arising from remelted fine turnings or grinding fines. This association selects the fine-turnings branch. WCO HS 2022 Chapter 72 Note 1(g) sets cast-form, surface-defect and chemical exclusions. US CBP N351850 documents a contrary case where continuously cast billets were semifinished steel. Current CPC 39340 concerns unmelted scrap, 39310 steelmaking residues. The original carbon-steel-only draft was not supported by this alloy case.
review.primary_evidence: The original customs description and photograph establish a physical product and downstream function. They establish neither this study’s batch nor a fixed composition or furnace technology. Inspect actual analytical, photographic, weighing and first-acceptance records. The steel-industry BREF informs relevant conditional measurements and does not supply site results.
review.measurement: The matched cohort denominator is first-released ingot dry mass, distinct from sales and returns. Reconcile source turnings, molten metal, net ingots and separately measured slag, dust and losses. Inspect electricity, chemical/fuel purchases, utilities and outsourced service boundaries under the actual plant-specific route. For metal bands and wood pallets count purchases, initial external non-purchases and proven return of the same issued article separately.
review.readiness: The two languages each contain 57 atomic exchange cards. Fifty-five row-specific identities remain unbound. Independent targeted check performed 288 checks with zero skips, retaining 39 missing-range warnings. Verify actual site/provider, chemistry, input attribution, net acceptance and residual destinations. Scientific and formal translation review remain pending.
review.original_native_records: Independent versioned native reads returned the bilingual remelting-ingot Product flow and its Mass reference. The electricity Product flow is limited to 1–35 kV Chinese grid-average consumption delivered to user and references Net calorific value. The historic 01.01.000 display names are retained for that lookup; 01.01.003 also read independently uses different display names and preserves the specific native property. No such provider is presumed for the Algerian customs case. The separate physical meter uses Energy; that property cites version 01.00.000 of an energy group which the inspected archive supplies as 03.00.003.
